title: Fix missing BTC monthly liquidity zones (ensure 27k–25k lower box appears and untouched boxes never disappear)

requirements.text: Fix the monthly BTC liquidity detection so the expected lower untouched liquidity zone around ~$27k–$25k is consistently emitted by the reversal-structure (two consecutive opposite candles → wick-based range) logic and appears in the computed liquidity model as a lower LiquidityBox with state='untouched' until first touch.

quotes: Your web is still not working right and not highlight the required points

acceptanceCriteria: With the current production BTC monthly candle dataset loaded, at least one lower LiquidityBox is present whose bounds cover the ~$27k–$25k area (i.e., minPrice and maxPrice fall within that expected zone).
The ~$27k–$25k box renders on the chart in the neutral/untouched style (not active) when price has not entered it.

If a reversal structure is detected that should produce the ~$27k–$25k lower zone but box creation is skipped, a development-only diagnostic warning is emitted including oppositeStartIndex, endIndex, computed wick/body bounds, and the skip reason.

requirements.text: Fix the liquidity box lifecycle so untouched liquidity boxes (touchCount===0) are never removed, suppressed, or silently not plotted for any reason other than explicit touched+cleared invalidation rules (i.e., no time-based cleanup, distance filters, trend-bias suppression, or structural replacement may hide untouched boxes).
acceptanceCriteria: For every LiquidityBox with touchCount===0, the algorithm returns state==='untouched' and the chart renders it (no missing boxes due to coordinate/index resolution).

No code path removes or filters out boxes solely because they are old, far from current price, or replaced by newer structure (unless they have been touched and then clearly cleared per the existing rules).

When a box cannot be rendered due to coordinate resolution failure, a development-only warning is logged that includes the box identifiers (minPrice, maxPrice, candleIndex, isUpper, state) and the resolved indices used for rendering.

requirements.text: Ensure the chart rendering path deterministically maps each LiquidityBox to x-axis coordinates using candleIndex (not timestamps) and does not drop valid boxes due to start-index lookup failures; if candleIndex is out of bounds, clamp it and still render the box from the nearest valid candle to the latest candle.
acceptanceCriteria: All boxes returned by the liquidity algorithm render as ReferenceArea overlays unless their state is 'cleared' (which must not be returned/rendered).
Boxes with candleIndex < 0 render starting at the first candle; boxes with candleIndex > last index render starting at the last candle; in both cases they extend to the latest candle.
Rendering uses stable React keys that prevent flicker/re-mounting when new candles load (keys include isUpper + candleIndex + bounds).

requirements.text: Add a small, deterministic developer regression fixture for liquidity detection (a minimal hard-coded candle sequence) that reproduces the missing-lower-zone scenario and verifies: (1) a lower box is emitted, (2) it remains present when untouched, and (3) it only disappears after touched+cleared rules are met.
acceptanceCriteria: A new development-only test/fixture (run in the frontend build/test environment) asserts that the computed liquidity model includes at least one lower LiquidityBox for the fixture sequence.
The fixture asserts untouched boxes remain in the returned model across recomputation when additional candles are appended that do not touch the box.
The fixture asserts a box is removed only when the fixture includes a confirmed touch followed by clear displacement satisfying the existing cleared criteria.

constraints: Frontend must not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only create backend/migration.mo if a state migration is strictly required.
Use English for any user-facing UI text and messages.
nonGoals: Adding new timeframes (the chart remains Monthly/1M only).
Changing the market data provider strategy beyond what is required to fix missing zones and ensure the chart works reliably.
Fixing Caffeine build/deployment infrastructure issues (e.g., internal configuration errors) beyond adding code-side diagnostics or safeguards.
